title: Galmaduwa Raja Maha Vihara, Ampara

titles.display: Galmaduwa Raja Maha Vihara, Ampara

description: Buddhist temple in Galmaduwa, Sri Lanka
extract: Galmaduwa Raja Maha Vihara is an ancient Buddhist temple in Galmaduwa, Sri Lanka. The temple is located on Hingurana – Ampara road approximately 6 km (3.7 mi) distance from Hingurana. It is believed that this temple complex was constructed during the reign of king Saddha Tissa. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. The designation was declared on 26 December 2014 under the government Gazette number 1895.
